item.title: New Chillicothe Police Officer
item.description: The Chillicothe Police Department will have a new police officer on Tuesday. Police Chief Jon Maples says the City Council approved Anthony Baucom. Comes with some experience and was a former Chillicothe Dispatcher Maples says the department is still down a couple of officers from full strength.

item.title: Wreaths Across America Dedication
item.description: Wreaths Across America, an organization that remembers the fallen and honors those who serve, will have a dedication ceremony for Livingston County on Friday, December 12th. The event will be held at 11:00 am at the south side of the courthouse at the war memorial. Everyone is welcome to attend!

item.title: Trial Canceled – Case Continued
item.description: A jury trial set for December 18th and 19th for Chad Alexander Holmes on charges of alleged child molestation has been canceled. In a recent court appearance, Holmes requested a continuance. The court granted the continuance and set the Pre-Trial conference for December 23rd. No new trial date has been set.
